justifications.unit: Unit tests drive the success, error, category-based validation and not-found assertions (sync and async) through real Either values and the real validation pipeline; left uncovered are the failure-message branches of the less used code-based and collection variants.
justifications.guard: The guard flag reaches only the nullable custom-message path of the category assertions; the assertion bodies run in the unit flag.

justifications.unit: Unit tests drive the streaming success/error assertions and the category-based ShouldContainValidationErrorForAsync; left uncovered are the cancellation and timing branches of the remaining streaming assertions.
justifications.guard: The guard flag reaches only the nullable custom-message path of ShouldContainValidationErrorForAsync; the other bodies run in the unit flag.
